in_marathi.name: Bhudevi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mother of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhudevi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhudevi is a Sanskrit name, derived from Bhuh (Earth) and Devi (Goddess). Bhudevi is considered the mother goddess of the earth, who nurtures and protects all living beings. In Hindu mythology, she is often depicted as the wife of Lord Vishnu and the mother of various deities.
